description: domains.createOrTransferDomain (POST /v7/domains) models its body as a top-level `method` property plus an add/move-in oneOf whose arms the request-body flattener drops, leaving only `method` — `name` (required by both arms) never reaches CreateOrTransferDomainRequest, so the operation cannot express which domain to add. Replace the requestBody schema with the flat merged object. NOTE (live-verified 2026-08-13): the SERVER also enforces the oneOf, and `method` has no enum in either arm, so a body of `{name, method: "add"}` matches BOTH arms and is rejected with 400 `should match exactly one schema in oneOf` — callers must send a bare `{name}` (plus optional cdnEnabled/zone) to add, and `{name, method: "move-in", token}` to move in. All fields optional except `name`; the add/move-in arm constraints are enforced server-side.

name.description: The domain name you want to add.

method.description: The domain operation to perform. Omit (or `add`) to add the domain; `move-in` moves a domain from another Vercel account using `token`. Live behavior: sending `method: "add"` together with `name` fails the server-side oneOf validation — omit `method` entirely when adding.

cdnEnabled.description: Whether the domain has the Vercel Edge Network enabled or not.

zone.description: Whether to create a DNS zone on Vercel. Set `true` if using Vercel nameservers (required before any DNS records can be created for the domain).

token.description: The move-in token from the Move Requested email. Only used with `method: "move-in"`.
